title: Kenworth T610 SAR Road Train FUPS Compliant Polished Aluminium Custom Built Bullbar #65
description: Kenworth T610 SAR FUPS Double Channel Road Train high tensile polished custom built aluminium bullbar. 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia pipe available. Steel plate over tow hitch (can be painted to suit chassis or chromed). Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Full length 100mm wide reinforced uprights (additional internal gussets) Stick-on Road Train signs with silver covers, cow catcher and 3 small uprights plus sump guard. Heavy duty mesh to centre section to protect radiator. Additional light bar mounted to bonnet. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
